race.description: The Local Pools & Spas Sprint Hcp
race.comment: Tough one to kick us off. RIVER OF ROME (7) is a Snitzel colt from Iffranesia, making him a full brother to Beadman on debut for the Waller yard. Looked much better in the latest trial when second over 818m at Warwick Farm. J Mac sticks from the trial and is sure to figure prominently. HIT THE SUMMIT (5) is a Richard & Will Freedman trained colt by Hitotsu from the good producing mare Aspen Summit on debut. Savaged the line in his recent trial win over 900m at Canterbury. Genuine contender. INFALLIBLE (9) is a fast filly by Hellbent from Aesop's Fable on debut from the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Has looked sharp in the two trial wins over 740m. Outside the draw the slight niggle. WHISPER (11) is worth a look.
